newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares seen firm, interest selective.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares seen firm, interest selective.

text.p: Shares ended firmer but in modest volume with interest highly selective. Volume should pick up after the semi-holiday in the U.S. but investor interest will continue focused on few stocks, traders said.
Ship repairer Lisnave was again the most actively traded stock after more details emerged at the end of last week on its restructuring. It closed 14 percent higher at 595 escudos.
Trade was also active in Sonae Investimentos and the rights to Inparsa, the new holding for the group's industrial and media interests.
PSI-20 index gains 0.71 percent to 6,175.19 points.
